discovery: Prediction and discovery of baryon acoustic oscillations in the large-scale distribution of galaxies, establishing a standard ruler for cosmic expansion

nominees.name: Rashid Sunyaev
nominees.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics, Garching, Germany

motivation: Sound waves in the primordial photon-baryon plasma leave a characteristic scale, about 150 Mpc, imprinted in the clustering of galaxies. Sunyaev (with Zel'dovich) predicted these acoustic oscillations in 1970. In 2005 Eisenstein and collaborators in SDSS, and Cole and collaborators in the 2dF Galaxy Redshift Survey, independently detected the baryon acoustic feature in galaxy correlation function and power spectrum. Eisenstein also developed the theoretical and methodological framework that turned the feature into a robust standard ruler, largely immune to astrophysical systematics. BAO has since become the most reliable geometric probe of cosmic expansion, underpinning BOSS, eBOSS, DES and DESI, and giving the precise distance measurements behind the 2024-25 evidence that dark energy may evolve with time. It is a rare case where a clean theoretical prediction became a precision tool that now tests the standard cosmological model itself.
